name: Create a skill and attach it to the seeded Test Quality Reviewer agent
description: Skills Lab: create a skill from scratch, confirm it lands in the editor. Agent Editor: open the seeded 'Test Quality Reviewer' agent (server/src/db/seed.ts:371), switch to its Skills tab, and attach the new skill — confirmed by aria-checked flipping false->true on its row checkbox. Both steps are real writes through the UI (POST /skills, PUT the agent's skill links), but neither touches the LLM. Does NOT trigger a review run: run-executor.ts resolves the agent's LLM provider (container.llm) before it resolves skills, and that call throws unless a provider secret is configured — which the hermetic/CI stack deliberately does not have (README: 'No Playwright, no LLM, no API key'). No seeded review run exists for this agent to inspect instead (only the PR's built-in seed review at seed.ts:141 has one, and it is not linked to an agent). Running a review to show the skill in the Run Trace is therefore out of reach for a deterministic, key-free flow with the current fixtures — see e2e/INSIGHTS.md.
